description: Per-file provenance contract for every vendored OpenHands UI file. Enforced by structural and semantic upstream-adoption gates.
rule: Disk <-> provenance exact 1:1 equality; each provenance entry must belong to an approved source-scope path and satisfy source-policy semantic/privacy constraints. Strict per-entry repository/tag/commit/path/class/hash validation applies. Full source-scope adoption closure is resolved separately at source-vendor completion.

entry_shape.upstream_path: src/... (path within OpenHands repo at the frozen ref; must equal an approved source-scope entry and satisfy source-policy constraints)
entry_shape.local_path: apps/workspace/upstream/openhands/src/... (path in Xingwen; must resolve inside that root, no traversal)
entry_shape.upstream_source_sha256: 64-char lowercase hex sha256 of the exact upstream file at the frozen ref (must equal source-scope source_sha256)
entry_shape.vendored_sha256: 64-char lowercase hex sha256 of the vendored file after minimal adaptation (must equal actual on-disk file hash)
entry_shape.modified: boolean; false => vendored_sha256 == upstream_source_sha256; true => modification_reason required
entry_shape.modification_reason: null when modified=false; non-empty string when modified=true

source_of_truth: GitHub official repository + Tag v1.10.0 + 40-char SHA + upstream lock/source policy. Not any local clone.
